The <b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a usable scroll, sold by [[Clotho]]. You also get one for every relic you deliver to [[Gerry]] during [[Stranger sins|Stranger Sins]] questline. Using it grants a random recipe for use at the Alchemy Workbench. If all recipes are already known, using this will provide a random potion.
